q: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

s: fire and storm (around God) accompanies God (fire devours before him; very stormy around him)
q: A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

s: Israel is subject of judgment (God's judgment of his people) (God testifies against them)
q: Israel, I will testify against you.

s: sacrifices and offerings (of Israel) is status not rebuked (burnt offerings continually before God)
q: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

s: sacrifice of thanksgiving is required by God (to be offered to God)
q: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

s: sacrifice of thanksgiving results in glorifying God (whoever offers it)
q: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me

s: the wicked hates instruction
q: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

s: the wicked consents with thief (seen by the wicked)
q: When you saw a thief, you consented with him

s: God has title Mighty One
q: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks

s: the wicked participates with adulterers
q: and have participated with adulterers.

s: the wicked gives mouth to evil (tongue frames deceit)
q: You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

s: the wicked slanders brother (slandered by the wicked)
q: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

s: the wicked forgets God
q: you who forget God

s: judgment (God's judgment of his people) is called by God (he calls heavens and earth to judge his people)
q: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

s: God shines out from Zion
q: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

s: God owns animals and creatures (God's creation) (every animal of forest, livestock on a thousand hills, birds, wild animals)
q: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

s: God owns world (and all that is in it)
q: for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

s: God has need of none (does not need bulls or goats as food)
q: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

s: God is god of Israel
q: I am God, your God.
